messages:
Asha Patel: Flagging an issue from the Feb invoice batch: several customers show a net negative "reserved capacity adjustment" but the related metered GPU usage lines are missing. Example INV-17902 for AcmeCloud shows -$1,150 adjustment and no compute lines.
Priya Rao: How many customers hit? Any high-severity ones?
Asha Patel: So far I see AcmeCloud, StellarOps, Clearview, and two smaller accounts. Total affected ~6 invoices in the batch.
Liam Chen: I dug into billing-generator logs. The proration worker threw a `splitLineitemException` during aggregate phase for accounts with overlapping reserved + metered transitions. It then retried, which created duplicate invoice creates in Stripe for some customers.
billing-bot: billing-generator job 100122 status: WARN proration-step error for 6 accounts (logs: https://logs.internal/billing/100122).
Miguel Torres: On Stripe I see pairs of invoice.created events ~1-3s apart for some accounts, then a void for one of them. But the negative adjustment persisted and the metered line ended up unattached (invoice_id NULL).
Liam Chen: Root cause: recent change (commit 8d1fa2e) changed the atomic move of reserved credits during plan changes. Under certain timing it moves the credit line but loses the link for the metered line, leaving an orphan. The retry path wasn't idempotent, so a duplicate invoice could be produced.
Asha Patel: Can we void those wrong invoices and reissue corrected ones? Customers are getting surprised refunds.
Liam Chen: Proposed fix: deploy hotfix to add idempotency by external_id + 10s window and ensure the proration step restores invoice associations if it detects orphaned meter lines. Then re-run reconciliation on affected accounts to generate corrected invoices. I can roll and run the reissue script. Need finance approval to void/reissue for these customers.
Priya Rao: Need ETA for fix and a short customer message for support. Also include how refunds will be handled and whether billing dates change.
Liam Chen: Quick estimate: patch + deploy ~2h, reissue run ~30-45min, manual audit ~1h. Expected impact: 6 invoices, ~$18,600 gross exposure (mixed negative credits and missing compute lines). We'll void incorrect invoices and create corrected invoices with same billing period; any refunds will be reversed so net customer charges stay accurate.
Miguel Torres: Putting payout hold for affected accounts until final invoice set confirmed.
Asha Patel: Please prioritize. Add notes on each account and tag support.
Liam Chen: I'll run a query to find orphaned meter lines: ```sql
SELECT id, account_id, amount, description FROM line_items
WHERE invoice_id IS NULL AND period = '2025-02' AND type = 'metered';
```
Liam Chen: Deploying hotfix now (adding idempotency guard + proration association repair). Oncall is me tonight.
billing-bot: Deployment started: billing-generator -> v2.0.1-hotfix by liamchen at 2025-03-12T02:00:00Z.
Liam Chen: Re-run started at 1765440005.
Liam Chen: Re-run finished at 1765440055  created 6 corrected invoices, voided 5 duplicates, reattached 6 orphaned meter lines, reversed 4 phantom credits. Net delta after corrections: +$220 (rounding). Manual audit ongoing.
Priya Rao: Thanks 47 I'll draft a brief customer note: short explanation, apology, steps we took, and confirmation that we corrected invoices and reversed any unintended refunds. Sending draft in 30m for review.
Asha Patel: Good. Please also prepare a short RCA for #postmortems with mitigation steps.
Liam Chen: Will prepare RCA and attach logs + reconciliation CSV. Closing once audit complete. (1765440100)
